origin.checkpoint: CP-E05.3: preregistered paper session on new data before any S08 step
origin.reason: E05 passed on windows already seen by five experiments; the confirmation result depends on one trade. Only data produced after registration can confirm or refute the candidate.
origin.deviation_note: DEV-1 below changes the data source of the forward session with respect to the CANDIDATE outcome text of E05.

candidate.frozen: Identical to E05 g10. No parameter, feature or rule may change during the session; a change ends this session and needs a new specification.

data.bars: hourly klines of the real market (Binance Spot public market data, read-only, no account and no keys)
data.new_data_only: Decisions are evaluated only on bars that open after the session start, which follows the registration date.
data.warmup: The 101 daily closes before the start are needed for the features. They come from the same public klines and are used only as feature input; no trade is evaluated on them. Their source and digest are recorded at session creation.
forbidden: BTCUSDT-1h-forward-v1 and any path under data/forward (CP08 reserved)
data.why_not_testnet_prices: Testnet prices are those of the test market and were not checked against the real market; a signal must be judged on real prices. The testnet is used for the execution check below, not for the evidence on the edge.

execution.primary: Paper execution simulated by the S06 engine with the cost model above (same engine as the backtest). This is the evidence for the criteria.
execution.secondary_optional: The same decisions mirrored as orders on the Binance Spot testnet through the S07 runner with the operator's testnet keys, to observe real fills, fees and operational faults. It does not enter the edge criteria. It requires the S07 testnet smoke (still open) first.

duration.note: The candidate closed 16-17 trades per 1.5-2.4 years in the backtest (about 7-11 per year): 12 weeks give roughly 2-3 trades. Twelve weeks can show that the runner behaves as the backtest and that risk stays bounded; they cannot show that the edge exists.

checkpoints.when: 12 full weeks after the session start
checkpoints.decides: operational and fidelity criteria; stop rules

checkpoints.when: the first Monday 00:00 UTC, checked weekly, on which the session has at least 8 CLOSED trades; if that has not happened after 52 full weeks, P1.edge is not run and the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE
checkpoints.trigger_rule: The trigger depends on the number of closed trades only, never on the result. P1.edge is evaluated once: a failure closes the candidate, a pass is not repeated or extended, and nobody may wait for a better figure.

stop_rules_any_time: max_drawdown_mtm_pct < -20 -> the session is closed, outcome FAILED (backtest worst drawdown was -17.2%)
a decision taken with a feature computed from a bar not yet closed, or a change to the frozen candidate -> outcome INVALID
week12_operational: timeliness: for each day, the 00:00 UTC event is committed (status_log.at, wall clock, of the row whose detail is 'last event <bar>') no later than 2 hours after the bar; at least 95% of the days since the start; a late poll that processes several bars at once is measured on each bar
no day without decision because of the runner; missing market data are recorded as gaps and handled by the engine rule

fidelity: python -m crypto_decision_lab.session_fidelity exits 0 on the session (same decisions, orders, fills and balances as the engine on the session's own recorded bars; feature values equal to 12 significant digits, gap notes ignored). It certifies the internal consistency of the session, not the authenticity of the bars

definitions.equity_net_return_pct: net return of the session including the open position valued at the last open (as in the E05 backtest)
definitions.realized_net_return_pct: net result of the CLOSED trades only, over the initial capital; an open position is excluded
definitions.realized_gross_and_costs: gross result and costs of the closed trades only (entry and exit costs of each closed trade)
definitions.buy_and_hold: the constant LONG strategy of the same engine, with the candidate's initial capital, risk limits (max_exposure 0.5), fee and slippage, one entry at the first event of the session and valued at the same last event as the candidate; computed on the session's recorded bars
definitions.report: both equity and realized figures, the open position and its unrealized result are always reported side by side (E05 review R16)

criteria: realized costs <= 50% of the realized gross result of the closed trades
equity_net_return_pct >= buy and hold net return - 10 percentage points over the same bars (the rule must not give up most of a rising market)

week12.OPERATIONAL_PASS: all week-12 criteria pass -> the session continues unchanged to P1.edge
week12.OPERATIONAL_FAIL: a week-12 criterion fails -> the runner is fixed (never the candidate) and a new session starts; see restarts

restarts.rule: at most 2 restarts, each approved by the coordinator and recorded; the candidate, the features and the criteria stay frozen
restarts.clocks: week 12 and the 8-closed-trade count restart with the new session; closed trades of an abandoned session never count for P1.edge
restarts.deadline: P1.edge must happen within 78 full weeks after the START OF THE FIRST SESSION; otherwise the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE and the candidate is not confirmed

edge.CONFIRMED: all four edge criteria pass at P1.edge -> S08 criteria may be registered for a new release of this exact candidate
edge.NOT_CONFIRMED: an edge criterion fails at P1.edge -> the candidate is closed as REJECTED on forward data
edge.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 8 closed trades after 52 full weeks, or the 78-week deadline of the restarts is reached

prerequisites.what: Daily features in the session runners: paper.py and live.py compute only momentum_24h; daily_trend needs daily_decision, d_momentum and d_trend from daily_trend.daily_features, with at least 101 daily closes of history. Implemented: paper.PaperSession.create(features={momentum_days, sma_days}) and daily_trend.daily_features_at, which compute the same values as daily_features over the whole frame (tests/test_paper_daily.py). The optional live (S07) mirror still calculates only momentum_24h and is not covered.

A live market-data source for the paper runner: today it accepts only a snapshot or a lab feed; it needs read-only public klines of the real market with enough history for the warmup (about 2450 hourly bars; the current kline feed reads 30). Implemented: public_klines.PublicKlineSource (source kind public_klines): read-only public market data host, paginated 2600-hour history plus the open of the current bar, tolerant to missing hours, retries on throttling, a source outage sets DATA_ERROR and the next poll retries; a session on the live market must start at the current hour or later.
A scheduled runner on a machine that stays on (one poll per hour is enough), with the session directory backed up.
Independent non-Claude review of E05 (CP-E05.0-2) and of the code added for PRE-1 and PRE-2.
Only for the optional testnet mirror: S07 testnet smoke with the operator's keys.

Fidelity tool for the week-12 criterion: session_fidelity (python -m crypto_decision_lab.session_fidelity --session-dir ...) rebuilds the bars the session saw from its own history and events, replays the frozen candidate with the experiment-side features and compares the ledgers.

Report tool for the checkpoints: python -m crypto_decision_lab.session_report week12|edge --session-dir ... [--as-of ...]. week12: timeliness from status_log, unexplained missing days, fidelity, drawdown, stop rule; outcome OPERATIONAL_PASS / OPERATIONAL_FAIL / FAILED / NOT_DUE. edge: realized net of the closed trades, equity net and drawdown, realized costs against gross, buy and hold of the same engine on the recorded bars, the open position and its unrealized result; outcome CONFIRMED / NOT_CONFIRMED with at least 8 closed trades, INCONCLUSIVE after 52 weeks without them, NOT_DUE otherwise; the edge report is written once (p1-edge-report.json) and a second evaluation is refused (exit code 2). Tests: tests/test_session_report.py. Run weekly on Monday 00:00 UTC.

evidence_to_record: session meta: candidate digest, engine_sha256, feed identity, start, warmup digest
weekly: equity, drawdown, decisions taken on time, gaps, closed trades
at each checkpoint: report with the criteria above, observed values and outcome, committed to reports/e05-p1/

at P1.edge: the report with equity and realized figures side by side, the open position and its unrealized result, the buy and hold figure and the outcome; at each restart: coordinator approval and reason
threats: Few trades even at the edge checkpoint (8): the confirmation stays weak; the comparison with buy and hold and the drawdown bound limit the damage of a wrong CONFIRMED.
One asset, one regime: 12 to 52 weeks may fall entirely in a rising or falling market.
Paper fills at the open with assumed slippage; real fills are observed only in the optional testnet mirror and, later, with minimal capital under S08.

Warmup bars are read once and frozen in the session history (INSERT OR IGNORE): a later revision of a warmup bar is not seen; Binance does not revise closed bars in practice, and the features stay consistent with the stored history (review R17).

Judging the edge on realized trades only is stricter than the E05 backtest, whose confirmation passed through the unrealized gain of an open position (review R16): a candidate that holds a winning position at the checkpoint is judged on what it has already closed.

deviations.from: E05-daily-trend-v1.json, acceptance.outcomes.CANDIDATE: paper session on new data with Binance Spot testnet klines, S06/S07 runner, operator's keys
deviations.to: paper session on real-market public klines (read-only market data host, no account, no keys), execution simulated by the S06 engine with the backtest cost model; testnet only as an optional mirror of the orders that does not enter any criterion
why: the signal must be judged on real prices; testnet prices come from the test market and were not compared with the real market
no keys are needed for the evidence, so no credential risk and no dependence on the S07 testnet smoke, which is still open
the engine, features and costs are exactly those of the backtest, so the fidelity check can compare the session with the engine
deviations.what_is_kept: frozen candidate, new data only, at least 12 weeks before any S08 step, own criteria
deviations.requires: explicit approval by the coordinator recorded in approvals before preregistration; E05 itself stays unchanged (its text is part of the preregistered specification)

approval.note: DEV-1 approved in chat: forward evidence on real-market public klines with simulated execution; testnet only as an optional order mirror outside the criteria. The specification itself is still DRAFT: it is preregistered separately, after the report tool (PRE-7) and the non-Claude review.
